newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian bond spreads marginally tighter.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian bond spreads marginally tighter.

text.p: Australian bond yield spreads to other dollar bloc bonds were marginally tighter, reserving an initial widening following the Reserve Bank's decision to leave monetary policy unchanged after Tuesday's board meeting.
However, there is some speculation that the central bank could ease policy later this week and after it sees the latest report on wages on Thursday.
The unchanged policy stance saw the local yield curve flatten slightly.
For the meantime, all eyes will focused on events in the U.S. with the two-day Federal Open Market Committee meeting drawing to a close, although it is widely expected to leave policy unchanged.
